## Tubes for water

The water that reaches the leaves of a tall neem tree travels up from the roots through long, thin tubes in its xylem. These tubes run the whole height of the tree.

**Predict:** Are most of the cells that form these water tubes living or dead?

options.text: Living, because only living cells can carry water up a plant.
Dead, with thick walls and nothing inside them, so they form open tubes.
Half living and half dead, taking turns to carry water each day.
